# storage.read

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Read a value from the current storage.

```lua
storage.read(label)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | yes |  |

## Returns

The value read

## Examples

```lua
local function read(widget)
  widget.source = storage.read("source")            -- a saved Source comes back as a Source
  widget.threshold = storage.read("threshold") or 33 -- default for widgets saved by an older version
end
```

Use it inside `read` callbacks of widgets, tasks and sources. Values live in the model file. See [Saving settings](../../guides/storage.md).

=== "Example 3"

    function widget.read()
        local storedPage = storage.read("currentPage")
        if storedPage then

        end
    end
